notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines SMSG_MESSAGECHAT with per-type sender prefixes plus the chat-adjacent small bodies (SMSG_NOTIFICATION, SMSG_CHAT_PLAYER_NOT_FOUND, SMSG_PLAYED_TIME, MSG_RANDOM_ROLL) and the wire-gated $-macro expansion set. MSUI's Program.Chat.cs HandleMessageChat matches every per-type shape Benilla reads (monster inline-name shapes, SAY/PARTY/YELL double guid, CHANNEL, single-guid default) and handles SMSG_NOTIFICATION; CMSG_MESSAGECHAT sends match messagechat_kind.
